description.value: It is the pheromone gland of a rotworm queen.
It opens every locked forum thread.
Only a brave and true hero of TibiaHispano can possess it.
It contains the scribings of many knowledgeable Tibians. It was awarded by Tibia.Fandom.com.
If you use it wisely, you may write yourself into the history books. It was awarded by Erig.
It proves that you have killed a vampire lord.
It is made of holy water and smells lightly of garlic. Sounds better than it actually tastes.
This could be turned into a great weapon against vampires.
It was made with holy water and garlic. You should be able to bake garlic bread - eww.
There is garlic cookie dough on it.
The garlic in it is well hidden. Nevertheless, you don't want to eat those. Yuck.
Julius gave it to you to have at least five unusual spots on Vengoth marked.
It is charged with magic energy, but that won't last forever.
It seems to be an old diary written by someone called Marziel, but a lot of pages are ripped out.
Use it on your bed to change the bed to green.
Use it on your bed to change the bed to yellow.
Use it on your bed to change the bed to red.
Use it on your bed to change the bed to blue.
It has the power to store magic energy.
